timeline.summary: Shri Shree Kumar Bangur disclosed no new encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for West Coast Paper Mills Ltd., filed April 3, 2026.
India Ratings affirmed West Coast Paper Mills' bank loan facilities of ₹620 Cr at IND AA/Stable/IND A1+.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,245.3 Cr (+19.6% YoY), net profit ₹53.98 Cr (+17.0% YoY).
West Coast Paper Mills disclosed consolidated related party transactions of ₹17.35 Cr for the half year ended March 31, 2026.
